findings.summary: Spec 'Required acceptance evidence' items 4 and 5 are unsatisfied. Item 4 demands a live drill against the real bus refs endpoint (not a mocked adapter): publish a human work.decision.v1 whose refs carry the actual gate question-note entity id, invoke resume, show decision-to-resume latency under 5s, and record real entity/message ids, UTC timestamps, argv/API invocation, exit status, and raw tail. Item 5 demands a restart-idempotency drill against the same development/run context with the same evidence shape. The implement handoff verification_record (.dev-dispatch/handoffs/453a9ada-fedf-50ce-b9b5-53e8a460af50/implement.json) contains only the three dd-acceptance commands (uv sync --frozen, make verify, uv run pytest -q -k resolver) with no drill output. No live-drill evidence exists anywhere in the worktree: no logs, no JSON evidence objects, no drill records in .dev-dispatch/. The only harness aimed at these drills, scripts/e1_decision_bridge_acceptance.py, uses a FakeBus and FakeOwner (its own module docstring states both scenarios run 'against a *fake* bus and a *fake* resume owner'), which item 4 explicitly excludes ('not a mocked adapter'), and there is no recorded execution of it. This is the same blocker that caused the prior final review (rf-ac560194) to REJECT; the current attempt's verification_record is essentially identical and did not add the required live drills.

The prior minor finding (resolver short-circuit on payload.question_note_id) is resolved in this attempt. _referenced_questions (src/fleet_graph/decision_bridge/resolver.py:91-122) now establishes the answered question exclusively through the reverse-refs endpoint (GET /v1/entities/<question>/refs) and explicitly does not trust an inline payload.question_note_id; _stale_reason (resolver.py:218-219) re-checks the same referenced set. test_inline_question_note_id_is_not_trusted (tests/test_decision_bridge.py:305-316) verifies that a decision carrying payload.question_note_id resolves nobody when the refs endpoint does not name it. The real bus refs endpoint contract ({"refs": [{"message_id", "target_entity"}]}) is correctly established throughout BusClient.refs_to (src/fleet_graph/bus/client.py:163-166), Board.decision_for (src/fleet_graph/bus/board.py:347), the resolver reverse-lookup, and the bridge _refs_to seam (src/fleet_graph/decision_bridge/bridge.py:279-290). The focused resolver suite (14 tests, all passing) exercises the correct contract shape. The change is minimal and the code-level correction is sound; the rejection is solely for the missing live-drill acceptance evidence.
